simple.meaning: אֵפוֹ (ʼêphôw) is a Hebrew object word meaning “strictly a demonstrative particle, here ; but used of time, now or then.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 27:33. The surrounding context includes family, family line, land, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: strictly a demonstrative particle, here ; but used of time, now or then
definitions.full: H645. epho אֵפוֺ ( Job 17:15 ; 19:6 , 23 ; 24:25 ), elsewhere אֵפוֺא (compare רִבּוֺ and רִבּוֺא ), enclitic particle then (probably from מּוֺ , a particle with a demonstrative force, compare מֹּה מּוֺ, here, with א prefixed. In the Targs. מּוֺן is used somewhat similarly, e.g. Gen 26:10 ; Num 11:29 ; Isa 1:9 ; 48:18-19 ,), — used 1 in connection with interrogatory pronouns or adverbs (like ἄρα , ποτε tandem): אֵפוֺא מִי Gen 27:3 who, then , . . . ? 27:37 ; אֶעֱשֶׂה מָה אֵפוֺא וּלְכָה and for thee, then , what shall I do, my son ? Exod 33:16 אֵפוֺא יִוָּדַע וּבַמֶּה and wherein shall it be known, then ...? אֵפוֺא אַיה where, then ? Judg 9:38 ; Isa 19:12 ; Job 17:15 ; Hosea 13:10 אֵפוֺא מַלְכְךָ אֱהִי Isa 22:1 אֵפוֺא מַהלָּֿח what is there to thee, pray . . .. 2 in a command or wish : 2Kin 10:10 אֵפוֺא דְּעוּ ? know, then ; (in apodosis) Prov 6:3 ; Job 19:6 , 23 מִלָּי֑ וְיִכָּֽתְבוּן אֵפוֺ מִיּיִֿתֵּן would, then , that my words were written ! 3 after אִם Gen 43:11 עֲשׂו זאֹת אֵפוֺא אִםכֵּֿן if it be so, then , do this, Job 9:24 if not then , who is it ? 24:25 .

occurrences.englishText: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”
Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh’s word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Yahweh has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”
The earth is given into the hand of the wicked.
